amendment: dc94485 = 7e3a05e + finalization latch. 7e3a05e gated the renderer END on a flag read AT the terminal, but R_SURFACE_QUIESCED is the last renderer record and by then X has died, the Activity has called setSharedState(NULL) and the GL thread has munmap'd the region, so the read saw NULL and the END never fired (measured: runtime-7e3a05e/r8-d/attempt-01, R8_INVALID PRODUCERS_NOT_FINALIZED, r_end=0). The flag is now latched when first visible with a live mapping.
build_id_note: build_id DID change for this transition (3658dd1f -> ed3e15a9 -> bc993eee) because native source changed, unlike fb4f017 -> b984ded where it was identical. The b984ded-era 'NON-DISCRIMINATING' note does NOT apply here. apk_sha256 remains the discriminating check regardless.
